passages.text: I have written eight of these guides since ChatGPT came out, but this version represents a very larg

When you are using any AI app (more on those shortly), including phone apps or websites, **the single most important thing you can do is pick the right model,** which the AI companies do not make easy. If you are just chatting, the default models are fine, if you want to do real work, they are not.
